## Processing chunks (one thing at a time)

```{r subset-setup, include=FALSE}
key_cols <- c(
  "subexperiment", "participant_id", "redundancy", "tab_away_count",
  "target_orientation", "started_outof_center", "too_fast_trigger", "num_items",
  "response_RT_from_start", "response_error_deg", "duration_ms",
  "response_orientation_360", "response_RT", "leave_center_RT", "cue_type",
  "too_slow_trigger", "trial_event"
)

subset_output_dir <- here("CSVresults", "subexperiment_keycols")
dir.create(subset_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

make_participant_id <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      participant_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        na_if(as.character(prolific_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(subject_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(uid), "")
      )
    )
}
```

```{r chunk1-extract-subsets}
# sub1 = subexperiment 1 (practice_effect)
# sub2 = subexperiment 2 (Context Effect Hypothesis)
# sub3 = subexperiment 3 (Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis)

sub1 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 1, experiment_type == "practice_effect") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub2 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 2, experiment_type == "Context Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub3 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 3, experiment_type == "Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))

subset_paths <- list(
  sub1 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub1_key_cols.csv"),
  sub2 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub2_key_cols.csv"),
  sub3 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub3_key_cols.csv")
)

cat("\n========== CHUNK 1: SUBSETS BY SUBEXPERIMENT ==========\n")
cat("sub1 (practice_effect):            ", nrow(sub1), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub1$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub2 (Context Effect Hypothesis): ", nrow(sub2), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub2$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub3 (Multiple Features Effect):  ", nrow(sub3), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub3$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
write.csv(sub1, subset_paths$sub1, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub1 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub1, "\n")
write.csv(sub2, subset_paths$sub2, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub2 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub2, "\n")
write.csv(sub3, subset_paths$sub3, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub3 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub3, "\n")
```

```{r chunk2-prep-clean-exclusions, message=FALSE}
# Common parsing helper for numeric columns saved as strings (e.g., "[123.4]")
parse_resp_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Trial-level exclusion thresholds (same for all 3 online subexperiments)
too_fast_ms <- 150
too_slow_ms <- 3500

prepare_response_data <- function(data, event_name, force_num_items = NULL) {
  out <- data %>%
    make_participant_id() %>%
    select(any_of(key_cols)) %>%
    filter(trial_event == event_name) %>%
    mutate(
      num_items = parse_resp_num(num_items),
      target_orientation_deg = parse_resp_num(target_orientation),
      response_orientation_360_deg = parse_resp_num(response_orientation_360),
      signed_orientation_error_deg = ((response_orientation_360_deg - target_orientation_deg + 90) %% 180) - 90,
      duration_ms = as.factor(duration_ms),
      rt_ms = parse_resp_num(response_RT_from_start),
      precision_deg = if_else(
        trial_event == "orientation_response_event" & !is.na(signed_orientation_error_deg),
        signed_orientation_error_deg,
        parse_resp_num(response_error_deg)
      ),
      abs_precision_deg = abs(precision_deg)
    )

  if (!is.null(force_num_items)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(num_items == force_num_items)
  }

  out
}

build_exclusion_table <- function(resp_df, subexp_label, too_fast, too_slow) {
  resp_df %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      Subexperiment = subexp_label,
      RawTrialCounts = n(),
      MissingTrials = sum(is.na(precision_deg)),
      TooFast = sum(!is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms < too_fast),
      TooSlow = sum(!is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms >= too_slow),
      CleanTrials = sum(!is.na(precision_deg) & !is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms >= too_fast & rt_ms < too_slow),
      SessionRemoval = 0L,
      MixtureRemoval = 0L,
      Retained = 1L,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

fit_mixture_model <- function(data_participant, period_deg = 360) {
  set_sizes <- sort(unique(data_participant$num_items))
  n_set <- length(set_sizes)

  if (n_set == 0) {
    return(tibble(kappa = NA_real_))
  }

  rad_scale <- (2 * pi) / period_deg
  lower <- c(rep(0, n_set), 1e-6)
  upper <- c(rep(1, n_set), 200)
  vm_cache <- lapply(set_sizes, function(ss) {
    x <- data_participant$precision_deg[data_participant$num_items == ss] * rad_scale
    x[is.finite(x)]
  })

  nll <- function(par) {
    alphas <- par[seq_len(n_set)]
    kappa <- par[n_set + 1]
    vm_const <- 2 * pi * besselI(kappa, 0)
    uniform_density <- 1 / (2 * pi)
    total <- 0

    for (i in seq_len(n_set)) {
      x <- vm_cache[[i]]
      if (length(x) == 0) next
      vm_density <- exp(kappa * cos(x)) / vm_const
      mix_density <- (1 - alphas[i]) * vm_density + alphas[i] * uniform_density
      total <- total - sum(log(pmax(mix_density, 1e-12)))
    }
    total
  }

  start_grid <- list(
    list(alpha = 0.05, kappa = 2),
    list(alpha = 0.20, kappa = 5),
    list(alpha = 0.40, kappa = 10),
    list(alpha = 0.60, kappa = 1)
  )

  fits <- lapply(start_grid, function(st) {
    par_init <- c(rep(st$alpha, n_set), st$kappa)
    tryCatch(
      optim(par_init, nll, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = lower, upper = upper),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })
  fits <- Filter(function(f) !is.null(f) && is.finite(f$value), fits)
  fit <- if (length(fits) == 0) NULL else fits[[which.min(vapply(fits, `[[`, numeric(1), "value"))]]

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    guess <- rep(NA_real_, n_set)
    kappa <- NA_real_
  } else {
    guess <- fit$par[seq_len(n_set)] * 100
    kappa <- fit$par[n_set + 1]
  }

  names(guess) <- paste0("pUniform_", set_sizes)
  as_tibble(as.list(c(guess, kappa = kappa)))
}

apply_mixture_exclusion <- function(clean_df, exclusions_df, cutoff = 40, period_deg = 360) {
  mix_tbl <- clean_df %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    group_modify(~ fit_mixture_model(.x, period_deg = period_deg)) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_cols <- grep("^pUniform_", names(mix_tbl), value = TRUE)
  ref_col <- NA_character_
  if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
    removed_ids <- character(0)
  } else {
    # Use the smallest set-size column available in this subexperiment.
    set_sizes <- as.numeric(sub("^pUniform_", "", p_cols))
    ref_col <- p_cols[which.min(set_sizes)]
    removed_ids <- mix_tbl %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[ref_col]]), .data[[ref_col]] >= cutoff) %>%
      pull(participant_id)
  }

  exclusions_updated <- exclusions_df %>%
    mutate(
      MixtureRemoval = if_else(participant_id %in% removed_ids, 1L, 0L),
      Retained = if_else(MixtureRemoval == 1L, 0L, 1L)
    )

  clean_updated <- clean_df %>% filter(!participant_id %in% removed_ids)

  list(
    clean_data = clean_updated,
    exclusion_table = exclusions_updated,
    mixture_table = mix_tbl,
    removed_ids = removed_ids,
    reference_col = ref_col,
    cutoff = cutoff
  )
}

# Event-specific extraction (kept from your preliminary script)
sub1_resp_raw <- prepare_response_data(sub1, "stimulus_wheel_display_event", force_num_items = 6)
sub2_resp_raw <- prepare_response_data(sub2, "stimulus_wheel_display_event")
sub3_resp_raw <- prepare_response_data(sub3, "orientation_response_event")

# Build participant exclusion tables before trial filtering
exclusions_sub1 <- build_exclusion_table(sub1_resp_raw, "sub1", too_fast_ms, too_slow_ms)
exclusions_sub2 <- build_exclusion_table(sub2_resp_raw, "sub2", too_fast_ms, too_slow_ms)
exclusions_sub3 <- build_exclusion_table(sub3_resp_raw, "sub3", too_fast_ms, too_slow_ms)

# Trial-level clean data (same criteria across all three subexperiments)
trial_clean <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(participant_id), !is.na(precision_deg), !is.na(rt_ms)) %>%
    filter(rt_ms >= too_fast_ms, rt_ms < too_slow_ms)
}

sub1_clean_trials <- trial_clean(sub1_resp_raw)
sub2_clean_trials <- trial_clean(sub2_resp_raw)
sub3_clean_trials <- trial_clean(sub3_resp_raw)

# Mixture-based participant exclusion (shared cutoff on smallest set-size condition)
mixture_cutoff <- 40
mix_sub1 <- apply_mixture_exclusion(sub1_clean_trials, exclusions_sub1, cutoff = mixture_cutoff, period_deg = 360)
mix_sub2 <- apply_mixture_exclusion(sub2_clean_trials, exclusions_sub2, cutoff = mixture_cutoff, period_deg = 360)
mix_sub3 <- apply_mixture_exclusion(sub3_clean_trials, exclusions_sub3, cutoff = mixture_cutoff, period_deg = 180)

# Final cleaned datasets used downstream
sub1_resp <- mix_sub1$clean_data
sub2_resp <- mix_sub2$clean_data
sub3_resp <- mix_sub3$clean_data

# Final exclusion tables
exclusions_sub1 <- mix_sub1$exclusion_table
exclusions_sub2 <- mix_sub2$exclusion_table
exclusions_sub3 <- mix_sub3$exclusion_table

cat("\n========== CLEANING SUMMARY ==========\n")
cat("Sub1 retained participants:", sum(exclusions_sub1$Retained), "/", nrow(exclusions_sub1), "\n")
cat("Sub2 retained participants:", sum(exclusions_sub2$Retained), "/", nrow(exclusions_sub2), "\n")
cat("Sub3 retained participants:", sum(exclusions_sub3$Retained), "/", nrow(exclusions_sub3), "\n")
cat("Mixture reference columns: sub1 =", mix_sub1$reference_col,
    ", sub2 =", mix_sub2$reference_col,
    ", sub3 =", mix_sub3$reference_col, "\n")
cat("Mixture cutoff (%):", mixture_cutoff, "\n")
```

```{r chunk3-plot-rt-precision}
# Shared position: R-cue slightly left, NR-cue (and Baseline) right at each duration
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
pj <- position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6, jitter.width = 0.15, seed = 42)

# --- Sub1: Precision (absolute response error) ---
p1_precision <- ggplot(sub1_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, position = pj) +
  labs(title = "Sub1 (practice_effect): Abs Precision", subtitle = "Set-size [6]",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute response error (deg)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p1_precision)

# --- Sub1: RT (plot only RT < 3000 ms) ---
p1_rt <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(sub1_resp, rt_ms < 3000), aes(x = duration_ms, y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, position = pj) +
  labs(title = "Sub1 (practice_effect): RT", subtitle = "Set-size [6] (RT < 3000 ms)",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "RT from start (ms)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p1_rt)

# --- Sub2: Precision (absolute response error), panels by set-size ---
p2_precision <- ggplot(sub2_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub2 (Context Effect): Precision",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute response error (deg)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p2_precision)

# --- Sub2: RT (plot only RT < 3000 ms), panels by set-size ---
p2_rt <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(sub2_resp, rt_ms < 3000), aes(x = duration_ms, y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub2 (Context Effect): Response time", subtitle = "RT < 3000 ms",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "RT from start (ms)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p2_rt)

# --- Sub3: Precision (absolute response error), panels by set-size ---
p3_precision <- ggplot(sub3_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
```
